notes: Haulers is open as a beta. Turn it on in Preferences (Haulers section) and it appears in the More menu: plan a hauling run leg by leg, pick from 767 datamined contracts, and see the load laid out on your ship's cargo grid. It will not guess travel time, arrival times or credits per hour, because Star Citizen does not publish what those would need, and the load order assumes your stops run in the order you entered them. Ship cargo grids now come from the game files instead of a community table, and each grid carries the box sizes it accepts, so a contract whose boxes will not fit your ship is flagged before you accept it. Those box rules are amber, not red: the numbers are the client's but are not yet confirmed against the game. Fixed: the leg editor only offered mining commodities; switching a leg between Trade, Deliver and Sell ore wiped the cargo name; picking a ship in Best Runs now carries it into the run; contracts that do not publish a region say so instead of guessing. Server-side: the weekly anonymous-account cleanup was also deleting Discord accounts and signing returning players out. No data was lost, and it is fixed.
